nodes.name: Setup notes

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Select your Gmail OAuth2 credential on the 'Email owner' node.
2. Activate the workflow, then copy the production webhook URL (…/webhook/odysseus-post).
3. In the Convex Keys panel set ODYSSEUS_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL to that URL.
4. Post a message as Odysseus to verify the email arrives.

The payload fields come from Deal Pipeline Pro: event, threadId, kind, messageId, refs, contentPreview, sentAt.

nodes.notes: This stickyNote node documents the setup steps.
